title: PipeDream: Generalized Pipeline Parallelism for DNN Training
description: Identified that GPipe's synchronous pipeline creates a bubble — all workers stall between forward and backward passes. PipeDream introduced 1F1B (one-forward-one-backward) scheduling to eliminate the bubble, interleaving forward and backward passes to keep all stages active. Introduced weight stashing to maintain consistent gradient computation.
authors: Narayanan, Harlap, Phanishayee, Seshadri, Devanur, Ganger, Gibbons, Zaharia (Microsoft / CMU)
